positions.source_passage: Generative AI is both very broad and very specific. Is it the FDA's stance that devices that derive information from existing research and generate insights be termed generative? Causal AI models approach the task in a very different way and have more power in healthcare in terms of causal versus correlation analysis. I would recommend either a broader explanation of the AI enabled devices, or to create a causal ai proposal mirroring this one.
positions.position_gist: The commenter asks FDA to clarify the scope of what counts as "generative" AI and recommends either broadening the explanation of covered AI-enabled devices or issuing a parallel proposal addressing causal AI models, which they say operate differently from correlation-based generative models.
